summary: Recovery week — pull intensity entirely, Z1-Z2 only, let the 4-week adaptation land before the next base block. Knee management continues.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Active recovery — Z1-Z2 aerobic maintenance without accumulating fatigue; blood flow to accelerate tissue repair

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 60-70 rpm, <88W. Let legs loosen gradually, no surges.
Z2 steady aerobic ride, 80-90 rpm, HR 146-155 bpm. Conversational effort, RPE 4/10. If HR exceeds 158, reduce power.
Easy spin, power dropping to <80W. Let HR fall below 140 before stopping.

sessions.name: Easy Run
sessions.focus: Maintain running neuromuscular pattern and aerobic base; Z1-Z2 easy pace with zero musculoskeletal stress

steps.description: Z1 walk-to-jog, HR below 145 bpm. Gradual transition, legs loose.
Z1-Z2 easy run 6:15-7:00/km, HR 145-160 bpm. Conversational pace. If anterior knee pain occurs, back off to walk-jog immediately.
Z1 easy walk. Let HR drop below 130 before stopping.

sessions.name: Posterior Chain & Core
sessions.focus: Posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings) and core anti-extension — build muscular support for cycling/running and protect knee by strengthening hip stabilisers; RIR 2-3
sessions.notes: 2 rounds. 60-75s rest between exercises. No loaded knee flexion >60-70°. RDL 2x10 @ 20kg, Banded Glute Bridge 2x20, Single-Leg RDL 2x8/side (bodyweight or light dumbbell for counterbalance), Dumbbell Floor Press 2x10 @ 11kg each, TRX Row 2x10, Dead Bug 2x8/side, Side Plank from knee 2x25s/side. Skip or reduce Floor Press and TRX Row if shoulder reports discomfort.

steps.description: Leg swings 10 each direction/leg, hip circles 10 each way, bodyweight glute bridges 15 reps slow, band clamshells 15 each side. Activate glutes and open hips before loading.

2 rounds: Romanian Deadlift 10x20kg → Banded Glute Bridge 20 reps → Single-Leg RDL 8 each side → Dumbbell Floor Press 10x11kg → TRX Row 10 reps → Dead Bug 8 each side → Side Plank from knee 25s each side. 60-75s rest between exercises.
Hip flexor stretch 30s each, lying glute/piriformis stretch 30s each, hamstring stretch 30s each, child's pose 30s. Breathe slow.

sessions.name: Week-Closing Easy Spin
sessions.focus: Closing active recovery — aerobic maintenance and parasympathetic restoration before new base block begins; note RPE vs Monday as adaptation signal

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 60-70 rpm, <88W. Gradual build, no urgency.
Z2 steady aerobic ride, 80-90 rpm, HR 146-155 bpm. Same prescription as Monday — note if RPE feels lower at the same power. That's your adaptation signal.
Easy spin, power <80W, HR dropping below 135 before you stop.

summary: New base block begins — reintroduce aerobic volume progressively, 80% easy cycling, 1 quality Z3 tempo block, 1 strength session with knee rehab movements if pain resolved.

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic development, 30 min steady, build cardiac output

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Base
sessions.focus: Reintroduce TRX split squat at conservative depth if knee pain resolved; posterior chain foundation

sessions.name: Z3 Tempo Intro — 2x8 min
sessions.focus: First threshold-adjacent stimulus of new block — 2x8 min at Z3 (142-168W), build lactate clearance

sessions.name: Easy Run — Extended
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 easy run 28-30 min, aerobic base, monitor knee

summary: Base week 2 — extend aerobic ride duration, develop Z3 tempo on the bike, add single-leg stability in strength. Progressive 10% TSS rise.

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 steady aerobic, 30 min, HR 146-162 bpm, build aerobic engine

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Progression
sessions.focus: Add 3rd round to strength circuit, progress single-leg work, increase dumbbell load where RIR allows

sessions.name: Z3 Tempo — 3x8 min
sessions.focus: Extend tempo volume: 3x8 min at Z3 (142-168W), develop fat oxidation at higher intensities

sessions.name: Easy Run
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 easy 30 min, neuromuscular maintenance, aerobic base

summary: Build phase — introduce first true threshold work on the bike (Z4 intervals), raise overall TSS ~15% from base week 2. Strength shifts toward power endurance.

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic maintenance, keep easy volume high to support 80/20 distribution

sessions.name: Lower Body Power Endurance
sessions.focus: Increase load or reps on RDL and single-leg work, reduce rest to 45s for metabolic stimulus

sessions.name: Threshold Intervals — 3x6 min Z4
sessions.focus: First Z4 threshold work of the new block: 3x6 min at 169-195W, develop FTP and lactate threshold

sessions.name: Easy Run with Strides
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 easy 30 min with 4x20s strides at end — neuromuscular sharpening without load
